call-signs.csv.contentsIndicative: header 'Call sign,Product,Status,Type,Call Sign MMSI: Last Modified Date' (no BOM); 155,346 data rows. Status: 102,936 Allocated, 51,955 Reserved, 444 Available, 11 blank. Product (the licence class): 58,987 Full, 35,336 Foundation, 14,051 Intermediate, 1,881 Club, 90 Temporary Reciprocal, 45,001 blank. Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row (service discriminator, required-present but not carried into the normalised projection). Last-modified dates run 2016-07-23 to 2024-06-14. Anomalies preserved verbatim: two Excel date-mangled callsigns ('21-Feb' Reserved, '21-Oct' Allocated); lower-case 'g0jrk' and '2e1GTD'; interior-space 'G6 FMU'; and 465 four-, 39 six-, 34 seven- and 45 eight-character callsigns (heritage two-letter and reciprocal 'M/...' forms).

normalised--call-signs.csv.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,last_modified_date; 155,346 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning - not callsign-sorted, no clear date order). Status carried verbatim (Allocated/Reserved/Available and 11 blanks preserved); licence_class is the source Product verbatim (45,001 blanks preserved); last_modified_date ISO-rendered (day-first, verified by 61,880 day>12 values). The constant Type column is required-present but not carried. No whitespace trimming was needed. The Excel date-mangled callsigns ('21-Feb', '21-Oct'), lower-case forms and interior-space 'G6 FMU' are preserved verbatim.
